title: Unit Event — The Song of a Canary in Crisis — Episode6 Draw Strength From Everything

meta.Event: The Song of a Canary in Crisis
meta.Event Outline: As the 30th Anniversary Show approaches, Nene is hard at work preparing for her role as the Cowardly Canary. However, during a rehearsal, the director criticizes not her acting, but her singing...

rows.Line: A few days later

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Again, you're hiding how you're running out of breath with a vibrato! Focus on maintaining the same volume all the way through!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
You sound fatigued from the last part!
Who wants to see a tired canary sing? You need to increase your lung capacity! When you get home today, start adding fifty sets to your training regimen!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She's been practicing with me every single day since then. I had no idea Ms. Kazamatsuri would be such a strict teacher.)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Nene, your “habits” have to do with how your acting and singing are completely separate from one another.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: You can tell how someone's not used to performing in musicals since the way they sing feels very different from how they're acting...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: The way you sing is amplifying that effect, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: There's a uniquely beautiful quality to the way one can sing only as a child and it becomes really easy to rely on that.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Unfortunately, it also becomes tempting to focus solely on maximizing said natural ability that you can develop a habit of neglecting your singing technique.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: As a result, that person's singing will often “stick out” and not quite mesh with their acting.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Frankly, Kusanagi, you're just not seeing the big picture for this show.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So that's what the director meant...)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: The first hurdle's always the toughest, but things will become much easier once you learn a few tricks. However...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: You have a list of other problems to also worry about, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, I know...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: On the other hand, it also means there's nowhere else to go but up.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Remember what I said?
I'm going to cram absolutely everything I have to offer into your head.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Everyone's jaws are going to be on the floor when they see that you fixed so many problems in such a short amount of time...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I've made my decision...
I'm gonna learn everything I can from her and fix all my problems. I have to absorb everything she says...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (For the sake of our show's success...!)
bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, you guys!
Did Nene ever say if she saw the video we made for her?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, I've been wondering that too!
Did she reply after that?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, she said she watched it!
She also thanked us and said she's gonna try her best.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: She did?! Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I couldn't be happier that she enjoyed it. Thank you for suggesting that we make that video for her, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I simply said what first came to mind after noticing that you were all feeling a little down.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Also, I believe she ended up enjoying it so much because everyone here genuinely wished for her to succeed.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah, maybe...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But Nene has been a bit busier recently compared to normal. She's also been coming home rather late. I hope she isn't pushing herself too hard.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, is that true?
You mentioned before how you were worried about her having bags under her eyes... But now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, she's come to practice a couple of times all covered in mud.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She said Ms. Kazamatsuri's been teaching her... But what exactly? How does singing practice lead to that?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And Nene just keeps saying, “Don't worry about me. I'm fine.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know she really wants to become a better singer, but I wish I could help her more...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As I...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think you've helped her quite a bit already.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think I have a rough understanding of where Nene is right now emotionally...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She didn't tell me what I'm about to say directly, so it's just what I'm imagining right now...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But Nene received a nice boost of encouragement from the video message we all sent her.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Which leads me to believe that she feels more motivated than ever to try her best.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sure our support means quite a lot to her.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Looking in from the outside, it may seem like she's pushing herself a little too hard. Which can be worrying...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I have a feeling that Nene's doing her absolute best right now to answer our call.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: KAITO...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, wouldn't it be best for us to all just wait in anticipation for Nene to produce some spectacular results?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup yup! I totally agree☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Me too...
*Yawn*
I'm looking forward to seeing Nene play the Cowardly Canary very much.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Ack! Luka, stop! How many times do I have to say this? You can't sleep here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Huh?
All your phones are beeping and buzzing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, could it be...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is it Nene?! Did she send us a message?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, it seems so.
Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Lemme see too☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, don't shove!

rows.Speaker: Nene's Message
rows.Line: <Sorry for making you all worry so much. But...>

rows.Speaker: Nene's Message
rows.Line:
<I'm okay now.
Let's make our show a good one.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...
This means Nene figured out what was wrong, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It seems that way.
Now, all we need to do is prepare for the real thing...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. As KAITO just mentioned, we can look forward to seeing what Nene has in store for us...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And hearing what she's truly capable of!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!
The day of the 30th Anniversary Show
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The day has finally arrived.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Don't worry...
You did everything you possibly could until today.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I was even able to fix my habits enough to the point that Ms. Kazamatsuri felt satisfied.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (All that's left for me to do is to go on stage and give it everything I've got.)

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line:
Whoa, hey!
The person sitting towards the front... Isn't that Yuka Kazamatsuri?!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Don't look now, but check out who's sitting next to her!

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Is that...? Seiichi Amami?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-Whaaaaat?!?!?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-Wh-Wh-Wh-Wh-What's Mr. Amami doing here...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Apparently, he and Ms. Kazamatsuri are old friends. She invited him and he happily accepted.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-Why didn't you tell me this sooner?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Sorry...
I had my hands full with my own problems.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I doubt any of us were planning on cutting any corners, but this raises the stakes for our show quite a bit...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, since Nene and Tsukasa's heroes are here to see it...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That means...
We've gotta make it the most wonderhoy show in the history of forever!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Five minutes to curtain.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I am not about to disappoint Mr. Amami after witnessing him put on such a magnificent performance as Rio.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My Rio needs to be perfect...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm not the only one with a vested interest in this show...)

rows.Speaker: Nishie
rows.Line: Let's go knock their socks off.

rows.Speaker: Omori
rows.Line: Oh, we will.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Everyone here wants to put on the best performance we possibly can...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So, go out there and blow them away as the Cowardly Canary!)
